messages:
kevin (newhire): hey all, quick hiccup on my first day. i accepted the GitHub invite but the org is hidden and the page says "requires verified corporate email". i only have my personal email on GH and i set up SMS 2FA which keeps failing because the SSO page says SMS is disabled. who do i ping to get this sorted? :wave:
it-support: welcome kevin! our enterprise org enforces SAML + SCIM and we require a verified company email (alias) and non-SMS 2FA (webauthn or TOTP). please DM your github username and the invite email so we can check. if you only have SMS we can walk you through adding a TOTP app or registering a security key.
kevin (newhire): thanks  the invite went to kevin+onboard@personalmail.com and my GH username is kevincode. i don't have a YubiKey and was using SMS because my phone is old. any workaround?
it-support: two options: 1) add your corporate alias (kevin@redwood.example.com) to your GitHub account and verify it, then accept invite; or 2) we can change the invite to match your GH primary email (admin-side) and enforce SSO afterwards. because SMS is disabled by policy we strongly recommend TOTP (Authy/Google Auth) as a quick fallback.
onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable TOTP or register security key 4) Add SSH key -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
kevin (newhire): i have the corporate alias in my company email but not on GH. i'll add it and verify. also could you set me up with repo access once i'm in? i'll need runtime and models repos to ramp.
anna (manager): anna here  approved access for kevincode to runtime and model-onboarding for onboarding week. infra/private repos will need a short security checklist and separate approval. tagging @infra-ops to add once membership is visible.
it-support: resending invite to kevin@redwood.example.com and forcing SAML handshake. note: if you have multiple GH accounts accept the invite while logged into the account that has the verified corporate alias. running `gh auth status` helps confirm which account is active.
kevin (newhire): re-accepted after adding kevin@redwood.example.com, set up Authy TOTP and saved recovery codes. SSO completed and i can see the org now. thanks!
infra-ops: adding kevincode to team "eng" with read+PR on runtime and model-onboarding. for CI work, we also provision a deploy key per machine. if you need a personal access token for CLI automation, create one with minimal scopes and rotate it after first use. see https://redwood.example.com/devops/pat-guidelines
ci-bot: Automated: created deploy key (read-only) for kevincode on repo redwood-inference/runtime at 2024-07-12T10:12Z. remember deploy keys are repo-scoped and cannot push. Use personal access tokens for CLI tasks that require write.
kevin (newhire): followed the SSH doc, ran `ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519` and `ssh -T git@github.com` -> "Hi kevincode! You've successfully authenticated". attempted to clone `git@github.com:redwood-inference/runtime.git` and it worked. opened a tiny docs PR. :tada:
it-support: quick PAT tip: prefer `gh auth login --with-token` and avoid storing tokens in plaintext. revoke tokens at https://github.com/settings/tokens if lost.
infra-ops: note: for elevated repo push rights we require a short security form + manager sign-off. anna already approved read access; if you need push to runtime please file the priv request form.
kevin (newhire): all good for now, can clone and make PRs. thanks for the fast help everyone :thumbsup:
it-support: closing thread  reopen or ping #help if anything else is broken. :white_check_mark:
